title: Marvin Thomas Cancels Christmas on Terry in Raising Kanan
htmlContent:
In the most recent episode of Power Book III: Raising Kanan, Marvin Thomas reminded everyone why he is one of the most feared and loyal enforcers in the game as things took a turn for the worse. When Terry, a small-time dealer with big nerves, threatened to flip and go to the cops, Marvin made a chilling move that fans are still talking about: he canceled Christmas with him.

Terry Crosses the Line

Terry's inadequacy was the starting point. As tensions rise around Raquel's operation and the heat from law enforcement tightens, Terry finds himself cornered and scared. In place of staying, he plays his final card by threatening Marvin with the police and exposing the entire organization, including Raq's leadership and Marvin's daily operations. Marvin, initially trying to de-escalate, gives Terry a chance to back off the ledge. When it becomes evident that Terry is not bluffing and, even worse, that he might have already said too much, Marvin goes full OG. The hit is both clean and fast, but also brutal. Terry is taken out without hesitation. This is a stark reminder of the rules in this world and what happens when you come across the Thomas family.

Marvin’s Loyalty and Lethal Resolve

The objective of this scene is not solely to silence Terry. It's a crucial moment for Marvin's character arc. Marvin has spent years trying to demonstrate his improvement, attending anger management, mending his relationship with Jukebox, and showing more discipline. However, he still recognizes when it's time to handle business the old-fashioned way. Terry's death was not a punishment; it was a form of protection. Marvin is aware that leaking information can cause trouble. Furthermore, in the drug scene, one fearful runner can lead to the collapse of an empire.

A Season Turning Point

Terry's departure is crucial as Raq's crew is under pressure from rivals and the law. Marvin's decision proves that if the family is threatened, he will do anything to protect them, no matter how much he tries to grow. Loyalty and silence are essential in the Power universe. Marvin ensured there would be no loudmouth around to ruin the holidays or the business.
